verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents Postgres read replicas you can target by appending |replica to the username to offload reads from the primary, plus Vitess read-only regions. The changelog mentions branch switchovers, but there is no documented description of high-availability or automatic failover behavior. missing for 10: documented HA architecture and automatic failover semantics (RTO/RPO, failover triggers), explicit steps for adding/provisioning replicas, independent or hands-on corroboration of failover.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can add read replicas and rely on documented high-availability and failover behavior

citations.quote: They provide a way to reduce load on your primary instance by allowing you to read from a replica.
Append `|replica` to the end of your username for the branch you want to target
list configured Vitess read-only regions for the database's default branch
After starting a switchover, you can now list switchovers for a branch and show one by ID.
